newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS offers American Depositary shares.
newsitem.headline: PGS offers American Depositary shares.

text.p: Seismic and offshore service company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA said on Tuesday it had issued four million American Depositary shares (ADS) at $27.25 per share.
The price was equivalent to 177.30 crowns per share, the company said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.

PGS said the net proceeds of the offering wiould be used to expand the group's library of three-dimensional (3-D) multi-client seismic data, to repay outstanding debt under various credit facilities and for general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition and construction of marine seismic vessels.

The ADSs are offered through an underwriting syndicate managed by Prudential Securities Inc., Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Salomon Brothers Inc., Simmons & Co International and Cambridge Partners.
